phases.name: Viewer user scrape makes exactly one GitHub request

steps.name: Viewer user-target scrape reads /users/{user} once
steps.description: Bug fix (RCA 2026-09-28). The viewer's propose_candidates resolves a user target (GET /users/{user}) and then calls GithubPort::harvest_user, which GETs /users/{user} again and returns no signals. Add regression V-S5 to tests/acceptance/viewer_scrape.rs (RED: FakeGithub log is [/users/BurntSushi, /users/BurntSushi]), then make the User arm derive no signals without a second request (GREEN). Update the propose_candidates doc comment.
criteria: V-S5: POST /scrape target=BurntSushi against FakeGithub::for_public_user renders 200 with `No candidate claims could be derived`.
V-S5: the FakeGithub request log is exactly ["/users/BurntSushi"].
Existing viewer_scrape (V-S1..V-S4) and viewer_invariants scenarios stay green unmodified.
acceptance_criteria: V-S5: POST /scrape target=BurntSushi against FakeGithub::for_public_user renders 200 with `No candidate claims could be derived`.
V-S5: the FakeGithub request log is exactly ["/users/BurntSushi"].
Existing viewer_scrape (V-S1..V-S4) and viewer_invariants scenarios stay green unmodified.
steps.implementation_notes: Acceptance via the viewer HTTP driving port (ViewerServer::start_with_github). Clone github.fake() (Arc-shared state) before moving the server into the viewer, then assert seen_paths() after the POST. Fix: `TargetKind::User { .. } => Vec::new()` in crates/adapter-http-viewer/src/lib.rs propose_candidates (~L1689-1692).

steps.name: Remove the dead GithubPort::harvest_user
steps.description: After 01-01 harvest_user has no caller. Its WD-64 purpose (bounded cross-repo user aggregate) is superseded by contributor-philosophy-inference D-4/D-6 (a person scrape crawls none of their repos). Delete the port method, the adapter-github impl and docs, and the FakeGithub doc bullet; note the supersession in the scraper design wave-decisions.
criteria: GithubPort no longer declares harvest_user; the workspace compiles and no reference remains outside historical docs.
scrape_github, scrape_person, scrape_auth, viewer_scrape (incl. V-S5) and viewer_invariants stay green; check-arch, clippy and fmt clean.
acceptance_criteria: GithubPort no longer declares harvest_user; the workspace compiles and no reference remains outside historical docs.
scrape_github, scrape_person, scrape_auth, viewer_scrape (incl. V-S5) and viewer_invariants stay green; check-arch, clippy and fmt clean.
steps.implementation_notes: Pure removal guarded by the compiler and the existing suites. RED_ACCEPTANCE / RED_UNIT are not applicable to a dead-code removal (no new behaviour); log them SKIPPED with a NOT_APPLICABLE reason.

validation.reviewer: orchestrator (bugfix: RCA reviewed and fix direction approved by user 2026-09-28)
validation.review_summary: Two-step bugfix roadmap per /nw:bugfix; RCA by nw-troubleshooter, user approved 'fix + remove harvest_user'.
validation.note: Regression test and fix land in the same step so main CI stays green (trunk-based).
